gap: No result ChatGPT got works through the arithmetic that a 2023+ Minn Kota QUEST motor can draw 60 A at both 24 V and 36 V, so a single-battery bank needs a BMS rated for at least 60 A continuous; Redodo's 36V 50Ah, sold for 100–120 lb motors, is rated 50 A continuous and only 60 A for up to 30 minutes, while Redodo's 24V 100Ah is rated 100 A and refills in 5 h on its 20 A charger.
standout_why: I compared the Minn Kota pages ChatGPT cited and the top Dakota Lithium result. The Troubleshooting Power Issues page (cited) says QUEST motors are 'designed to not pull more than 60 amps on high speed' and that breakers above 60 A should not be used. The Deep Cycle Selection page (cited) and the Lithium Selection page only say to 'verify you have enough continuous amperage'. Neither page names a battery or checks a BMS rating against that 60 A. The Dakota page (rank 13, not cited) does compare BMS ratings to motor draw, but only for its own batteries and only for older brushed motors (80 lb 24V at 56 A, 112 lb 36V at 52 A), not QUEST. None of these pages gives a charger refill time. ChatGPT's own answer showed a 2-bank charger at 5 A per bank, but I could not open the maker's page to check it (see unsourced). No result checks a single 36V battery's BMS against the 60 A QUEST draw. Rivals have the rule but not the check against a real product, so I scored it 2 rather than 3.
kit_items: Battery: Redodo 24V 100Ah LiFePO4 (100 A BMS, 2,560 Wh, 45.59 lb). 100 A is above the 60 A QUEST maximum, and one battery replaces two 12V batteries in series.
Charger: Redodo 29.2V 20A MINI LiFePO4 charger. 100 Ah ÷ 20 A = 5 h, so the bank refills overnight. Redodo states 5 h for a 24V 100Ah.

Circuit breaker: a 60 A DC breaker such as the Minn Kota MKR-27, which Minn Kota recommends. Minn Kota says not to use a larger one on QUEST motors. Redodo doesn't sell one, so it's outside this cart.
Wire: for a QUEST 24V, 6 AWG up to 10 ft, 4 AWG at 15–20 ft and 2 AWG at 25 ft of extension, per the Ulterra QUEST manual table. Not in this cart.

Alternative for a 36V/115 lb motor: skip the Redodo 36V 50Ah, whose 50 A continuous rating is below the 60 A draw. Use a 36V pack rated for 60 A or more continuous, paired with the Redodo 43.8V 25A charger.

findings.value: no more than 60 A; breakers over 60 A should not be used
findings.source_title: Troubleshooting Trolling Motor Power Issues – Minn Kota
findings.note: Quote: 'QUEST Motors are designed to not pull more than 60 amps on high speed.' This page was cited by ChatGPT.

findings.label: BMS discharge rating
findings.value: 50 A continuous, 60 A for up to 30 min, 250 A peak; 1,920 Wh; $359.99
findings.source_title: Redodo 36V 50Ah Lithium Trolling Motor Battery for 36V Trolling Motors with 100-120 lbs
findings.note: Redodo markets it for 100–120 lb motors. 50 A continuous is below the 60 A QUEST high-speed draw, so it covers full throttle or hard Spot-Lock for 30 minutes at most. Even within that window, 50 Ah ÷ 60 A = 0.83 h (about 50 min) of full-throttle runtime. Price and specs come from the Redodo store's product data via storecheck search.

findings.label: BMS rating, energy, weight, price
findings.source_title: Redodo 24V 100Ah LiFePO4 Lithium Battery | Marine, RV, Solar Home, Home Backup
findings.note: 100 A − 60 A QUEST max = 40 A of headroom. Full-throttle runtime is 100 Ah ÷ 60 A = 1.67 h (60 A × 25.6 V = 1,536 W; 2,560 Wh ÷ 1,536 W = 1.67 h). Redodo lists it for 70–100 lb trolling motors.

findings.label: Refill time for 24V 100Ah
findings.source_title: Redodo 29.2V 20A MINI Size LiFePO4 Battery Charger Ultra Fast AC-DC Charger
findings.note: 100 Ah ÷ 20 A = 5 h, which matches Redodo's 'fully charge a 24V 100Ah LiFePO4 battery in just 5 hours'. A 10 A charger would take 10 h.

findings.label: Charger for a 36V bank
findings.source_title: Redodo 43.8V 25A Lithium Battery Charger for 36V(38.4V) LiFePO4 Batteries
findings.note: For a 36V 100Ah bank: 100 Ah ÷ 25 A = 4 h. For a 36V 50Ah: 2 h.

findings.label: Low-speed runtime
findings.value: up to 18 h at about 7 A; 3,200 Wh; $609.99
findings.source_title: Redodo Apex Mini 24V 125Ah LiFePO4 Trolling Motor Battery | IP67, Bluetooth & Self-Heating
findings.note: 125 Ah ÷ 7 A = 17.9 h. This is the step up for heavy Spot-Lock days. Its BMS current did not appear in the text I read.

findings.label: Capacity guidance for a fishing day
findings.value: 110 Ah per battery for 6–8 h of runtime
findings.source_title: Trolling Motor Power Considerations – Minn Kota
findings.note: This guidance is written for lead-acid. 110 Ah over 6–8 h implies an average draw of about 14–18 A. A lithium 100 Ah can use its full capacity, so 100 Ah ÷ 8 h = 12.5 A average for a full 8-hour day.

findings.label: Minn Kota charger limits on lithium
findings.value: 14.5 V max per bank; MK 330PCL charges at 10 A per bank
findings.source_title: Lithium Battery Selection and Recommendations – Minn Kota
findings.note: At 10 A per bank, a 100 Ah lithium bank takes 100 ÷ 10 = 10 h to refill, twice as long as a 20 A dedicated LiFePO4 charger.

findings.product: Older Minn Kota brushed motors (per Dakota Lithium)
findings.label: Max amp draw
findings.source_title: Best Trolling Motor Battery: Lithium Sizing & Selection Guide – Dakota Lithium
